smoke_workspace_layout: The declared research layout did not expose its panels and session controls.
settings_busy: The receiver is in use. Stop its playback tasks or choose Disconnect in the bottom task menu before applying hardware settings. Saved wideband settings are preserved.
reception.conflict: The receiver is serving an incompatible task. Stop that task, or select another receiver, then retry. Existing monitoring and recordings were kept.
reception.unsupported: No receiver-plugin recommendation meets the complete channel and sample-rate requirements. Check the selected receiver and antenna.
reception.readback_conflict: Actual receiver settings cannot cover this channel. Check the receiver readback and choose another configuration.
reception.error: The receiver could not start. Check the diagnostic details and retry.
reception.consumer_error: This input consumer failed. Other receiver tasks continue; inspect the details.
reception.source_ended: The receiver input ended. Check its connection and retry.
reception.disconnected: The receiver was disconnected. Choose a receiver and retry.
input_queue: Monitor input: {input} pairs, {rejected} rejected; queue peak {peak}/{capacity} bytes.
driver_report_pending: The shared input has no final driver report for this monitoring task. Missing hardware counters are unknown.
reception.monitor_queue_full: The monitoring input queue filled. Monitoring stopped to preserve an explicit sample timeline; independent playback and other receiver consumers continue. Check the input-queue and analysis load details.
settings_monitor_busy: Stop wideband monitoring before changing receiver hardware settings. Independent playback retains its own lease.
smoke_stop_usage: Use --smoke-stop-listening-after-ms with a positive delay and --smoke-seconds.
smoke_stop_unfinished: Monitoring did not finish after its stop action.
